utterances.speaker: granddaughter

utterances.speaker: grandfather

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Absolutely, Grandpa. I'll keep that in mind and make sure to drive safely. Thanks for the advice!

utterances.speaker: grandfather

utterances.speaker: grandfather

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Don't worry, you're doing just fine. The car is built to handle a lot, and I'm here to help if you need it.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Yes, you can accelerate gently now, and then smoothly increase your speed as you feel comfortable.

utterances.speaker: grandfather

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Let's find some shade or turn on the air conditioning to cool down a bit.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
